paite: Levi Tapate: Gershom, Kohath, Merari ahi uh.
heading: Siampu Liante Inkuan Khangthu

paite: Huan Kohath tapate: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, Uzziel ahi uh.
Amram tate: Aaron, Mosi, Miriam ahi uh. Aaron tapate: Nadab leh Abihu, Eleazar leh Ithamar ahi uh.
Eleazar in Phinehas asuang a, Phinehas in Abishua asuang;
Abishua in Bukki asuang a, Bukki in Uzzi asuang;
Uzzi in Zerahiah asuang a, Zerahiah in Meraioth asuang;
Meraioth in Amariah asuang a, Amariah in Ahitub asuang;
Ahitub in Zadok asuang a, Zadok in Ahimaaz asuang;
Ahimaaz in Azariah asuang a, Azariah in Johanan asuang;
Johanan in Azariah asuang a, amah Jerusalem a Solomon inn lam lai siampu nasep sempa ahi:
Huan Azariah in Amariah asuang a, Amariah in Ahitub asuang;
Ahitub in Zadok asuang a, Zadok in Shallum asuang;
Shallum in Hilkiah asuang a, Hilkiah in Azariah asuang;
Azariah in Seraiah asuang a, Seraiah in Jahozadak asuang;
TOUPA'N Nebukadnezzar khut a Judah leh Jerusalem apimang lai in saltanna lam ah Jahozadak apitel hi.
Levi tapate: Gershom, Kahath leh Merari Jahozadak ahi uh.
heading: Levi Suante

paite: Hiaite Gershom tapate minte ahi uh: Libni leh Shimei.
Kohath tapate: Amram, Ezhar, Hebron leh Uzziel ahi uh.
Merari tapate: Mahli leh Mushi ahi uh. Hiaite apipute uh inkote dungzui in Levite inkuante ahi uh.
Gershom a kipan: Atapa Libni, atapa Jahath, atapa Zimmah;
atapa Joah, atapa Iddo, atapa Zerah, atapa Jeatherai.
Kohath tapate: Atapa Amminadab, atapa Korah, atapa Assir;
atapa Elkanah, atapa Ebiasaph, atapa Assir;
atapa Tahath, atapa Uriel, atapa Uzziah, atapa Shaul.
Elkanah tapate: Amasai leh Ahimoth ahi a,
atapa Elkanah, atapa Zophai, atapa Nahath,
atapa Eliab, atapa Jeroham, atapa Elkanah.
Samuel tapate: Ata masapen Joel, azom Abiah ahi.
Merari tapate: Mahli, atapa Libni, atapa Shimei, atapa Uzzah;
atapa Shimea, atapa Haggiah, leh atapa Asaiah.
Huan hiaite David in thukhun bawm akhawl nung a, TOUPA insung a la a nasepna tung a heutu a akoihte ahi uh.
heading: Tempul A Tumging Tumte

paite: Jerusalem a Solomon in TOUPA' inn alam khit masiah, kihoupihna biakbuk ma ah la sa in nna asem uhi. Athupiak bang zel un anasepna uh ahih uhi.
Hiaite atapate toh nasemte ahi uhi. Kohath mite tapate ahihleh: Lasami Heman, Joel tapa, Samuel tapa;
Elkanah tapa, Jeroham tapa, Eliel tapa, Toah tapa;
Zuph tapa, Elkanah tapa, Mahath tapa, Amasai tapa;
Elkanah tapa, Joel tapa, Azariah tapa, Zephaniah tapa;
Tahath tapa, Assir tapa, Ebiasaph tapa, Korah tapa;
Ezhar tapa, Kohath tapa, Levi tapa, Israel tapa.
A-unaupa Asaph, ataklam pang a dinghpa, Asaph Berekiah tapa mahmah, Shimea tapa;
Mikael tapa, Baaseiah tapa, Malkijah tapa;
Ethni tapa, Zerah tapa, Adaiah tapa;
Ethan tapa, Zimmah tapa, Shimei tapa,
Jahath tapa, Gershom tapa, Levi tapa,
akhut veilam ah a-unaute uh Merari tapate: Kishi tapa Etham, Malluk tapa Abdi;
Hashabiah tapa, Amaziah tapa, Hilkiah tapa;
Amzi tapa, Bani tapa, Shamer tapa;
Mahli tapa, Mushi tapa, Merari tapa, Levi tapa.
A-unaute uh Levi mite Pathian inn biakbuk a nasepna tengteng a ding a aseh ahi uhi.

Himahleh Aaron leh atapate'n halmang maitam tung ah, gimlim maitam tung ah, Mun Siangthoupen a nasepna tengteng a ding in alan uh; Pathian sikha Mosi thupiak tengteng bang a, Israel a ding a tatna bawl ding in.
heading: Aaron Suante

paite: Huan hiaite Aaron tapate ahi uh: atapa Eleazar, tapa Phinehas, atapa, Abishua;
atapa Bukki, atapa Uzzi, atapa Zerahiah;
atapa Meraioth, atapa Amariah, atapa Ahitub;
atapa Zadok, atapa Ahimaaz ahi.
Huchi in hiaite agamgite ua apuanin kaihnate uh dungzui a atenna uh ahi: Aaron tapate kiang ah, Kohath mite inkote a, amau mun ding a ai san a piak masakpen ahi.
heading: Levite Tenna Mun

paite: Amau kiang ah Judah gam ah Hebron leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh apia uhi;
Himahleh huai a khopi munte leh khotate, Jephunneh tapa Kaleb kiang ah apia uhi.
Aaron tapate kiang ah kihumbitna khopite apia uh, Hebron; Libna leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Jattir, Eshtemoa leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh;
Hilen leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Debir leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh;
Ashan leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Beth-shemesh leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh.

Huan Benjamin nam a kipan; Geba leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Allemeth leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Anathoth leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh. A-inkuante tengteng a akhopite tengteng uh khopi sawm-le-thum ahi hi.
Kohath tapa omlaite kiang ah, huai nam inkuan a kipan, nam kimkhat, Manasseh nam kimkhat a kipan khopi sawm aisan a piak ahi uhi.
Huan Gershom tapate ahihleh, a-inkuante uh dungzui in, Issakar nam a kipan, Asher nam a kipan, Naphtali nam a kipan, Bashan a Manasseh nam a kipan, khopi sawm-le-thum ahi.
Merari tapate kiang ah aisan a piak ahi, a-inkote uh dungzui in, Reuben nam a kipan, Gad nam a kipan, Zebulun nam a kipan, khopi sawm-le-nihte.
Israel suante'n Levi mite kiang ah khopite leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh apia uhi.
Judah tate nam a kipan, Simeon tapa nam a kipan, Benjamin tate nam a kipan, hiai khopi minlohte, aisan in apia uhi.
Kohath tapa inkote lak a khenkhatte'n Ephraim nam a kipan amau gamgi khopite anei uhi.
Amaute kiang ah bitna khopite apia uh, Ephraim singtang gam a Shekem leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh; Gezer leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh;
Jokmeam leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Beth-horon leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh;
Aijalon leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Gath-rimmon leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh;
Manasseh nam kimkhat a kipan Aner leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh; Bileam leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Kohath tapate inko lak a omlaite a ding in.
Gershom tapa kiang ah, Manasseh nam kimkhat inkuan a kipan a piak ahi; Bashan a Golan leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Astaroth leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh,
Issakar nam a kipan in: Kedesh leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Daberath leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh;
Ramoth leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Anem leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh,
Asher nam a kipan in: Mashal leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Abdon leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh;
Hukok leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Rehob leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh,
Naphtali nam a kipan in: Galili a Kedesh leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Hammon leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Kiriathaim leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh.
Levi mite omlaite kiang ah, Merari tapate, Zebulun nam a kipan a piak ahi, Rimmon leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Tabor leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh,
Jeriko a Jordan khen, suahlam pang, Reuben nam a kipan, amaute piak ahi, gamdai a Bezer leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Jahzah leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh,
Kedemoth leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Mephaath leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh,
Gad nam a kipan in: Gilead a Ramoth leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Mahanaim leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh,
Heshbon leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Jazer leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh.
